info.title: convenr API
info.description: Everything a person can do on the convenr pages, as JSON over HTTP. Creating an event returns an admin secret, and joining one returns a participant token; each is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. A refused request gets an RFC 9457 problem with a stable `code`. Within version 1 a response may gain fields, problem codes and enum values, so a client ignores what it does not know. A request holds only the fields its schema names.

patch.description: Changes the fields the request names and keeps the others. A schedule is replaced as a whole. When the change would remove slots that participants chose, it is refused with `confirmation_required`, which carries the number of participants in `losing` and the current `ETag`; repeat the same change with that `ETag` as `confirmedVersion` to accept the loss. The loss is accepted only while the event still has that version; after any other change the refusal comes again with the new count. `If-Match` is a separate guard: a change that sends it is refused with `event_changed` when the event has another version, so it never overwrites what the client has not seen, but it never accepts a loss.

200.description: The event after the change, or as it was when nothing changed.
